# What Vivado 2026.1 made of each design here, on xc7a100tftg256-1, from
# `FIXTURE=fifo tools/vivado-parity/lutram.sh`. `routed` is its count of
# FIFOs and block RAMs after routing, `pin` each pin of the cell `dut`,
# its net and the site pins that net reaches at the cell's site
# (lutram_probe.tcl), `tile` each block RAM tile of its bitstream
# decoded through this repository's database, `clocks` what reaches the
# tile's clock and control pins, and `refused` each design rule it
# refused a bitstream by: tests/fpga_xray_fifo_vivado.rs says how to
# read each.
